description: This file defines a final class 'DistributedPubWithTopicExtractor' which implements 'DistributedPub' interface. It acts as a wrapper around another 'DistributedPub' instance and adds functionality for extracting topics from messages via 'PubSubTopicExtractor'. It provides methods to get a publisher actor reference and to wrap messages for publication, integrating topic extraction.

classes.name: DistributedPubWithTopicExtractor
classes.description: A package-private implementation of 'DistributedPub' that delegates publication and adds topic extraction functionality for messages.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of 'DistributedPubWithTopicExtractor' with specified delegate and topic extractor.

methods.name: getPublisher
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef for publisher resulting from delegate's getPublisher() method.

methods.name: wrapForPublication
methods.description: Wraps a message for publication by extracting its topics and creating a Publisher message.
